extracted.name: Absolutely The Best Shrimp Scampi
extracted.description: Shrimp sauteed in olive oil, with a brandy sauce flavored with garlic shallots and oregano. Great served with a rice pilaf and salad!
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds fresh shrimp, shelled and deveined without tails
instruction_lines: Combine flour, black pepper, salt, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl. Dredge shrimp in flour mixture.
Sauté shrimp in olive oil in a large skillet over high heat for 5 minutes, stirring often; transfer to a broiler-safe serving dish using a slotted spoon, leaving oil in the skillet.
Sauté garlic, shallot, parsley, and oregano in same skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Spoon over shrimp. Return skillet to stovetop.
Meanwhile, preheat the broiler for medium heat.
Add wine and brandy to the skillet over medium heat; ignite with a match or lighter. When flames die down, stir to loosen any browned bits on the bottom of the skillet; pour over shrimp.
Broil shrimp in the preheated broiler for about 2 minutes.
